closed_boundary_semantics: Both children contain the rational split boundary; duplicate coverage is allowed, gaps are not.
threshold_identity: Threshold is part of every cell identity; sigma and 67/250 trees are distinct proof objects.
global_pass_rule: Every root-hull point must terminate in a proved safe leaf or a certified admissible counterexample; no UNRESOLVED/RESOURCE_STOP leaf is permitted for global PASS.
serialization_rule: Unresolved cells and checkpoints are durable and resumable; navigation buffers never alter proof boxes.
